description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the class FeaturePropertyModified, which appears to be an event class related to modifications of feature properties within the Eclipse Ditto framework. The tests verify immutability, equality/hash code, JSON serialization/deserialization, and input validation.

classes.name: FeaturePropertyModifiedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for FeaturePropertyModified, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization, and input validation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that FeaturePropertyModified instances are immutable and that JsonPointer and JsonValue are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correct implementation of hashCode and equals methods for FeaturePropertyModified class.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Ensures that creating a FeaturePropertyModified instance with null ThingId string throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Ensures that creating an instance with null ThingId object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatureId
methods.description: Checks that null feature ID input leads to NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPropertyJsonPointer
methods.description: Checks that null JsonPointer for the property leads to NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPropertyValue
methods.description: Ensures NullPointerException is thrown when property value is null.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method produces the expected JsonObject representation.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating a FeaturePropertyModified instance from a valid JSON string and verifies its fields.
